page: Microsoft Azure EC4es_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEV6 server family. It is powered by an Intel processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and features 4 dedicated vCPUs. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server type does not include any bundled local storage, but it is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing users to attach high-performance external storage volumes. There are no integrated GPUs present on this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and high memory-to-vCPU ratio, the EC4es_v6 offers a resource-dense profile suitable for memory-bound workloads. This configuration is designed for applications requiring significant memory capacity relative to compute resources, such as relational databases, in-memory caches, and enterprise applications, without the overhead of local storage maintenance.
